searchText: b"h remaining work — universal portal + stable ui + production repair the awtsmoos renews every route, datum, control, and deployment from nothing into sight; awtsmoos.com must therefore join calm human interfaces to universal resource contracts and prove them live in production light. current mission state completed architecture / source foundations [x] three planning/critique passes completed and preserved without overwrite. [x] actual api federation/router patterns inspected from real files. [x] existing social entity, relationship, activity, provenance, drive resource, schema, and ui foundation patterns inspected. [x] compatibility first portal architecture chosen: existing domain apis remain authoritative; portal adapts rather than silently breaking them. [x] universal resource envelope contract implemented with forward compatible extensions. [x] namespaced/versioned type contract implemented. [x] action, relationship, bounded query, structured error, provenance, job, and transformation contracts implemented. [x] portal limits/primitives implemented. [x] deterministic type registry, built in types, and capability root modules implemented. [x] first real compatibility adapter implemented over the existing apifamilycatalog abstraction. [x] read only portal service, handlers, route family, and api family catalog registration implemented. [x] universal ui stabilization begun with calm neutral tokens, solid actions, fields, choices, feedback, motion, prose, lists, tables, media/code, and semantic structure fallbacks. production blockers — highest priority [ ] reproduce the user's live https://awtsmoos.com/apps/ failures from production http/browser evidence. [ ] trace and repair get /scripts/awtsmoos/ui/foundation.js?v=universal ui 001 returning 404. [ ] trace and repair /apps/scripts/apps filter.js?... returning application/json to a module request in production. [ ] prove local and production module requests return javascript mime with successful status. [ ] prove /apps/ has zero site owned runtime exceptions, failed module loads, or unintended static 404s after deployment. [ ] separate browser extension mises safe injected / ethereum noise from site owned failures. universal ui work still required [ ] complete responsive.css for small screen dialogs/sheets, safe areas, long content, navigation, tables, and mobile viewport behavior. [ ] rewrite geelooy/style/universal ui.css completely with the final deterministic import order. [ ] re read every universal ui source file completely after the final first pass. [ ] ensure every touched css source file remains under 120 lines and uses tab indentation where indentation exists. [ ] verify no futuristic default gradients/glass/glow remain in the universal fallback layer. [ ] extend runtime ui auditing for navigation list markers, dialog labels, viewport escaping code/pre, target sizing, accessible names, and horizontal overflow. portal client / ux work still required [ ] build portalapiclient and resource normalization client modules. [ ] build deterministic renderer selection/registry modules. [ ] build semantic field registry and bounded unknown value renderer. [ ] build generic, collection, api family, unknown, and developer inspector renderers. [ ] build /portal/ as a calm mobile first real surface over the live portal api. [ ] make /portal/ browse real registered types and real api family resources. [ ] make unknown types render safely before specialized renderer code exists. [ ] add resource inspector showing type, id, schema, links, capabilities, metadata, extensions, and renderer choice. [ ] keep api provided presentation semantic only; never execute server supplied html/css/module paths. api / data platform work still required [ ] add contract tests for minimal/maximal envelopes, unknown fields, malformed types/actions/queries, error resources, provenance, jobs, and transformations. [ ] add adapter equivalence tests proving legacy api family identity/path/description survive portal adaptation. [ ] add registry/capability root tests. [ ] add actual http probes for /api/portal/, /types, /type, /api families, and /api family. [ ] inspect and add additional real domain adapters only where current authorization/contracts are proven: drive/files, social entities/activity, forms, typed tools/jobs. [ ] do not advertise fake executable actions/jobs/transforms without a real authorized backend. whole site ui / runtime work [ ] finish and run the runtime quality audit against /apps/, /portal/, and representative page families. [ ] run mobile 360/390, tablet 768, desktop 1440, and cinema 1920 viewport verification on representative complex pages. [ ] audit public routes for module mime failures, static 404s, uncaught errors, root overflow, unstyled native risk controls, and missing accessible names. [ ] repair every current site owned failure with complete file rewrites only. [ ] preserve specialist game/editor/media identity while sharing safe controls/errors/accessibility/mobile foundations. mandatory readback / delta [ ] read every file touched by this mission completely after the implementation pass. [ ] write a new first pass delta comparing all plans with actual source. [ ] rewrite complete files for every discovered delta. [ ] re read all touched files again. [ ] run line count/tab/jsdoc/import/export/cycle/public contract checks. verification [ ] run syntax checks for every touched js/mjs source. [ ] run relevant existing tests plus new portal/ui/runtime regressions. [ ] run api http probes on the local server. [ ] run local chrome console/network/runtime checks with cache disabled. [ ] run static asset and javascript mime checks. [ ] verify no unrelated regression in /api/catalog. git / deployment [ ] capture fresh full git status, branch, head, remotes, and concurrent agent changes. [ ] classify every changed path as this mission, user work, concurrent agent work, generated artifact, local only artifact, or secret risk. [ ] preserve and include all safe unrelated work as explicitly requested; never publish secrets/local hazardous artifacts blindly. [ ] inspect the repository's real deployment mechanism from config/scripts/workflows. [ ] commit the complete safe requested tree. [ ] push canonical github branch. [ ] verify remote branch head equals local head. [ ] execute the real deployment mechanism. [ ] verify deployed commit/version where observable. [ ] re run /apps/, /portal/, portal api, and representative runtime/ui audits against https://awtsmoos.com/. [ ] give the user only a url that has been directly verified after deployment. next action read the current /apps entry/module paths and /scripts/awtsmoos/ui tree, then probe local and production http responses for the exact failing urls before rewriting any responsible source file.
